headline: THIS ROW DID NOT HOLD. The re-drive found the undo broken on the one path a reader actually takes, and it was fixed before this row was allowed to keep its `matched` status.

toast.verdict: consistent (250ms polling granularity accounts for the difference)

undoInsideToastWindow.verdict: Cmd+Z undid the completion, exactly as recorded

undoAfterToastExpired.result: did NOT undo — the task stayed completed
undoAfterToastExpired.verdict: NEW FINDING. Todoist's undo is also bounded by the toast window, which had never been measured. meologue's undo was scoped to the toast window as a design decision; this shows that decision matches Todoist's actual behaviour rather than merely resembling it.

todoist.methodNote: Presence of the row in the DOM is NOT a completion test — a completed Todoist task lingers struck through. The signal is the checkbox's own aria-label/aria-checked, which is what this row already records.

theDefect.symptom: Completing a Task by clicking its checkbox and then pressing z or Ctrl/Cmd+Z did nothing. The undo silently failed.
theDefect.rootCause: Clicking a checkbox leaves focus ON that checkbox, and `isTypingTarget()` returned true for ANY element whose tagName is INPUT — a checkbox included. So the guard reported 'the reader is typing', every binding was suppressed, and the undo never fired.
proof: focus after completing via checkbox: { tag: INPUT, type: checkbox }
Cmd+Z with focus still on the checkbox -> task back: false
focus moved to a BUTTON, Cmd+Z -> task back: true
theDefect.whyTheSuiteMissedIt: jsdom never leaves focus where a real pointer click does, and the existing tests drove the binding with focus already on a row button. The fix-phase browser check also focused elements deliberately rather than completing a Task the way a person would.
theDefect.breadth: This suppressed EVERY binding while a checkbox held focus, not just undo — the same latent problem one row deep.

theFix.change: `isTypingTarget` now asks 'is the reader typing text into this?' rather than 'is this an input?'. A denylist of non-text input types (checkbox, radio, button, submit, reset, file, image, color, range) is excluded; everything else, plus TEXTAREA and any contenteditable, still counts as typing.
theFix.whyADenylist: so an unfamiliar or future text-ish input type still keeps its keystrokes rather than silently losing them
theFix.timeInputDeliberatelyOmitted: a time input's own arrows change its hour and minute, so it IS capturing the keyboard and must stay a typing target
theFix.noArrowDrivenInputsToBreak: checked for radio and range — there are none

verifiedAfterFix.textFieldStillProtected: typed 'safety check' into the composer with an undo pending, pressed Cmd+Z: the text was undone and the completed task stayed completed

verdict.undo: AGREES after the fix, on both keys, from the path a reader actually takes.
verdict.undoScope: AGREES — both apps bound the undo to the toast window.
verdict.statusStands: Yes, but only after a fix. Had the re-drive not been run, this row would have kept a `matched` status it did not deserve, describing an undo that did not work when used normally.
